name: Window Frame Ties Exclusion: EXCLUDE TIES for Unbiased Cumulative Totals
description: In financial ranking, when multiple entities have the exact same score, evaluating cumulative rank metrics without self-reinforcing duplicate ties prevents tied participants from skewing percentiles.
prompt:
In financial ranking, when multiple entities have the exact same score, evaluating cumulative rank metrics without self-reinforcing duplicate ties prevents tied participants from skewing percentiles.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: player_id, score, cumulative_score_excluding_tied_peers.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Calculate cumulative score excluding tied peers at the current rank
            SELECT 
                player_id,
                score,
                SUM(score) OVER (
                    ORDER BY score DESC
                    RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                    EXCLUDE TIES
                ) AS cumulative_score_excluding_tied_peers
            FROM gaming_scores
            ORDER BY score DESC, player_id;
why_it_fails: Tied participants mutually inflate each other's cumulative metrics.
